# DataTalks.RU

> > A comprehensive Russian-language resource for data engineers covering orchestration, distributed systems, and modern data stack technologies.

DataTalks.RU provides learning materials, documentation translations, and practical guides for data engineering professionals. The site focuses on Apache Airflow, Trino, and other enterprise data tools with Russian translations and tutorials.

## Key Topics

- Apache Airflow
- Data Engineering
- Data Pipeline
- Orchestration
- Trino
- PySpark
- Apache Kafka
- ClickHouse
- Kubernetes
- DAG Workflow
- Medallion Architecture
- dbt
- System Design
- Python

## Getting Started

- [Главная - DataTalks.RU. Data Engineering / DWH / Data Pipeline](https://datatalks.ru): DataTalks.RU roadmap for data engineers covering tools, pipelines, and system design

## Orchestration & Workflows

- [Airflow Docs (RU)](https://datatalks.ru/airflow-docs): Russian translation of Apache Airflow documentation and Astronomer Learn guides

## Query Engines & Data Warehousing

- [Trino 479 документация — Trino 479 Documentation](https://datatalks.ru/trino-docs): Trino 479 documentation with installation, security, and deployment guides
